entities.summary: Nadezhda Andreyevna Yermakova is a Belarusian economist, member of the Presidium of the All-Belarusian People's Assembly since 2024 representing the civil society through the Women's Union of Belarus. She was the chairwoman of the National Bank of the Republic of Belarus between 2011 and 2014 and of the Belarusbank between 1996 and 2011.
